name: kc-ai-plugins
description: Workflow plugins for Claude Code and Codex, each bundling a few related skills.

plugins.name: doc-qa
plugins.description: Document a project, QA Web UI with Playwright or desktop UI with available Codex computer-use, and export results as PDF.

plugins.name: owl
plugins.description: Hand agreed work to an unattended agent: write a dispatch whose tests match production, run it with locks and resumable state, and accept the result against the live environment.
